body.name: All-active projection differentiation handle
body.construction: For an admissible compact family \(\mathcal K\), evaluate each \(Q\)-specific recursion on \(\mathcal U_{\mathrm{rr}}\), differentiate the full-past projection and every positive square-root residual along an arbitrary ambient empirical-process direction \(h\) satisfying \(h[1]=0\), and apply \([\dot{\mathfrak R}_T[h]]_Q\) coordinatewise to \(\phi_T\). The handle is a uniform von Mises expansion using the common envelope bound \((\delta_{\mathrm{mom}},B_{\mathcal E})\), chart and identification margins \((\varepsilon_{\mathcal B},\varepsilon_{\mathrm{id}},c_{\mathrm{id}})\), rank bounds \((\underline j,\underline x)\), overlap \(\eta\), and interior margins \((\underline\kappa,\underline\rho)\) to control every row-averaged second-order remainder.
